service.description: Name of the service this repository builds.

tech.description: Technical owner, usually a GitHub handle.

data_class.description: The most sensitive data the service handles.

maturity.description: Sets every check's default mode. Bronze enforces only manifest validity; silver also enforces docs impact, contracts, waivers, generated files and supply chain; gold enforces every check.

modes.description: Overrides the default mode of a check. Each key is a check key from the rule reference (for example `docs.impact`).

docs.description: Where the docs live and which code changes they must follow.

diataxis.description: Docs follow the Diátaxis structure: tutorials, how-to, reference and explanation.

roles.description: Reader roles the docs serve, for example `end-user`, `admin`, `developer`.

impact_map.description: Changed code paths and the docs that must change with them (QK010).

paths.description: Globs for code paths, for example `internal/config/**`.

docs.description: Globs for the docs that must change when those paths change.

generated.description: Files that must equal their generator's output (QK020).

cmd.description: The command that generates it, run from the repository root.

contracts.description: Contract files checked for breaking changes.

security.description: Where threat models and specs live.

specs_dir.description: Spec folder. A new spec here needs a threat model (QK040).

replaces.description: Tools this system replaces. When set, a parity matrix is required (QK051).

runbooks.description: Runbook folder; every alert must reference a runbook here (QK080).

feedback.description: Where user feedback and follow-up work go.
